piezas.titulo: Word reading: Opinion essay and structure
texto: Reading and spelling of discourse theory and academic writing concepts: «ข้อโต้แย้ง» combines «ข้อ» (falling tone), «โต้» (mid-class consonant ต with the vowel โ and the mark ้, falling tone) and «แย้ง» (low-class consonant ย with the vowel แ and the mark ้, high tone). «ย่อหน้า» has «ย่อ» (low tone with the mark ่) and «หน้า» (falling tone with หนำ). «สนับสนุน» has four syllables: «ส» (low tone), «นับ» (low tone with the implied หนำ cluster), «ส» (low tone) and «นุน» (rising tone with implied หนำ over น). «หักล้าง» has «หัก» (low tone with ก in the แม่กก group) and «ล้าง» (high tone with the mark ้ over ล).
